info.name: WalkMate API
info.description:
Comprehensive Postman Collection for WalkMate Backend APIs (UC-01 to UC-43).

## Quick Start
1. Create a Postman Environment.
2. Set `baseUrl` = `http://localhost:8080`.
3. Run **UC-01 Register** or **UC-02 Login** : the test script automatically extracts `accessToken` and `refreshToken` from `ApiResponse<T>.data` and saves them to the environment.
4. All secured endpoints inherit the collection-level **Bearer {{accessToken}}** auth : no manual header setup needed.

## ApiResponse<T> Wrapper
Every response is wrapped as:
```json
{ "success": true|false, "data": <T>|null, "error": null|{"code":"...","message":"..."}, "timestamp": "ISO-8601" }
```
Validation errors return HTTP 422 with `error.code = VALIDATION_ERROR` and `error.message` as a comma-separated `field: reason` string.

item.name: E2E Integration Flow
item.description:
Full realistic user lifecycle for Collection Runner automated end-to-end testing.

Scenario: Two strangers register, match publicly, complete a walk, become friends, then walk together privately.

── Phase 1: Setup & Authentication (Steps 1–2) ─────────────────
  Register User A (Alice) and User B (Bob). Tokens and user IDs extracted from JWT.

── Phase 2: The First Encounter — Public Match (Steps 3–9) ──────
  User A posts an OPEN intent. User B posts an overlapping intent, triggering an
  inline match. Both accept the proposal, mutually activate, and complete the walk.

── Phase 3: Post-Session & Social Connection (Steps 10–13) ──────
  User A reviews User B. User A sends a friend request. User B accepts it.
  They are now friends — private invite is unlocked.

── Phase 4: The Second Encounter — Private Invite (Steps 14–18) ─
  User A creates a private intent inviting User B. User B accepts. Both activate.

Run via: Postman Collection Runner → select "E2E Integration Flow" folder → Run All.
See README.md in this folder for full setup instructions.

Backend behavior (I-7, P-1):

  - Both intents set to MATCHING.

The receiver intent is system-generated and never surfaces in public OPEN list.

Prerequisite: User A and User B must be ACCEPTED friends (Step 13).

Authenticated via {{userA_token}}.
